Definition: from G4253 and G3539; to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself):--provide (for).
BiblicalUsage: Pronoeo means to consider in advance, to look out for beforehand. Paul tells the Romans to provide things honest in the sight of all men, and the Corinthians to provide for honest things in the sight of the Lord and of men, and Timothy that a man who provides not for his own has denied the faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe providing honestly is a witness, and the man who looks out for his own household preaches with his hands.
